text:
Coveted, forbidden,

you are near, one step away, enchantress.

With your eyes you offer yourself to whoever passes,

whoever looks at you, ripe, overflowing,

whoever asks for your body as for a grave.

Wicked young girl, virgin,

burning, closed,

I see you and love you,

your blood in tumult,

your head turning and rising,

your body horizontal on the grapes and smoke.

You are perfect, desired.

I love you and your mother when you are together.

She is still beautiful and has

what you know nothing of.

I don't know which of you I prefer

when she straightens your dress

and lets you go to look for love.

translation.title: Coveted, Forbidden
